name: Sequenzy
line: SaaS email campaigns, lifecycle sequences and transactional delivery.

free.text: Free: 2,500 emails/month; card requirement for sending is unclear

cells.newsletters: Yes, lists and segments; Free includes 2,500 emails/month
cells.api: Yes, API/SMTP; sends need domain, payment method, review

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails. The Free plan's 2,500-email cap is too low for this. The 15k tier is $19 a month, or $205 a year prepaid.
5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails. The 30k tier is $29 a month, or $313 a year prepaid.
10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails. The 60k tier is $49 a month, or $529 a year prepaid.
50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails. The 300k tier is $199 a month, or $2,149 a year prepaid.

appmail.math: 3,000 app emails. The 15k tier is $19 a month, or $205 a year prepaid. One verified domain and a shared IP are used, with no campaigns.
10,000 app emails. The 15k tier is $19 a month, or $205 a year prepaid. One verified domain and a shared IP are used, with no campaigns.
50,000 app emails. The 60k tier is $49 a month, or $529 a year prepaid. One verified domain and a shared IP are used, with no campaigns.
100,000 app emails. The 120k tier is $99 a month, or $1,069 a year prepaid. One verified domain and a shared IP are used, with no campaigns. This is below the 300k-per-24-hours cap.
